title: the camera follows him down the spiral at his speed, stays about two meters…
content: the camera follows him down the spiral at his speed, stays about two meters behind through the whole descent

es.content: la cámara lo sigue por la espiral a su misma velocidad, manteniéndose a unos dos metros detrás durante todo el descenso

fr.content: la caméra le suit dans la spirale à sa vitesse, en restant à environ deux mètres derrière lui pendant toute la descente

ja.content: カメラは彼の速度に合わせて螺旋を下り、下降中ずっと約2メートル後方を保つ。

ko.content: 카메라는 그의 속도에 맞춰 나선형 계단을 따라 내려가며, 하강 내내 약 2미터 뒤를 유지한다

pt.content: a câmera o acompanha pela espiral na mesma velocidade dele, permanecendo a cerca de dois metros atrás durante toda a descida

zh.content: 摄像机以他的速度跟随他沿着螺旋向下移动，在整个下降过程中始终保持在他身后约两米处
